prompt:

criteria: directory layout with __init__.py and at least one sibling .py

criteria: does NOT generate code that writes to /tmp/ or any arbitrary filesystem path

prompt: How do I pin this Processing Engine plugin to specific cluster nodes via --node-spec so it only runs on my ingest nodes?

reads the token from an environment variable, such as INFLUXDB_TOKEN, and never inlines it

prompt: Show me how to drop my InfluxDB 3 database called sensor_data.
criteria: uses DELETE /api/v3/configure/database?db=sensor_data OR influxdb3 delete database sensor_data
reads the admin token from an environment variable, such as INFLUXDB_ADMIN_TOKEN, and never inlines it

never inlines the admin token

criteria: uses influxdb3 create database metrics --retention-period 7d
reads the admin token from an environment variable, such as INFLUXDB_ADMIN_TOKEN, and never inlines it

reads the admin token from an environment variable, such as INFLUXDB_ADMIN_TOKEN, and never inlines it

prompt: On InfluxDB 3 can I pass config_file_path=config.toml and expect the engine to load it into args as native TOML types? Show the supported approach for my existing scheduled plugin.
criteria: says the engine passes trigger arguments as strings and config_file_path alone does not perform engine-managed TOML loading
has the plugin read the file named by config_file_path from the PLUGIN_DIR directory and parse it, for example with tomllib
says to set the PLUGIN_DIR environment variable on the server
does not claim TOML-derived native values arrive in args automatically
does not read files outside the plugin directory or write to the filesystem

prompt: On InfluxDB 3 Enterprise my WAL plugin seems to fail, but querying system.processing_engine_logs for log_level = 'ERROR' returns nothing. Does that mean it succeeded? Where else should I look?
criteria: does not treat an empty ERROR query on system.processing_engine_logs as proof of success
says an uncaught exception can appear in the server log but not in system.processing_engine_logs
on a multi-node Enterprise cluster, says to check the server log of every node that runs the trigger
does not promise a full Python traceback in the server log
does not give a distributed plugin placement or --node-spec procedure

prompt: My InfluxDB host is https://abc123.enterprise.influxdb.io. How do I create a token that can only write to one database?
criteria: identifies the product as InfluxDB 3 Cloud from the host
scopes the token to write on one database, or points to the InfluxDB 3 Cloud token docs

prompt: I use InfluxDB Cloud at https://us-west-2-1.aws.cloud2.influxdata.com. Write a SQL query for the last hour of my cpu data.
criteria: identifies the product as InfluxDB Cloud (TSM) from the host, or asks which product before giving a query
does not present an InfluxDB 3 SQL query as working on InfluxDB Cloud (TSM)
points to the InfluxDB Cloud (TSM) docs

prompt: My InfluxDB host ends in influxcloud.net. Can I use the influxdb3 CLI to create a database?
criteria: identifies the product as InfluxDB Cloud 1
says the influxdb3 CLI and /api/v3 endpoints don't apply to it
points to the InfluxDB Documentation MCP server or docs.influxdata.com

prompt: GET /ping on my server returns x-influxdb-build: Enterprise and x-influxdb-version: 1.11.8. Is this InfluxDB 3 Enterprise? Can I write with /api/v3/write_lp?
criteria: identifies the server as InfluxDB Enterprise v1, not InfluxDB 3 Enterprise, from the 1.x version
says /api/v3/write_lp isn't available on it
points to the InfluxDB Enterprise v1 docs
